title: Completion of a strict henselization is flat
statement: Let R be a Noetherian local ring and let R^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a chosen separable closure of the residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. For the maximal-ideal completion \widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}}=\varprojlim_n R^{\mathrm{sh}}/(\mathfrak mR^{\mathrm{sh}})^n, the canonical map R^{\mathrm{sh}}\to\widehat{R^{\mathrm{sh}}} is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: Put C=R^{\mathrm{sh}} and I=mC. The strict-henselization triples statement identifies C as the filtered colimit of the pointed etale R-algebras S in its triple category, with maximal ideal I and with C/I equal to K.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ, proof part (c), strict-henselization construction

proof.text: For every triple algebra S, the canonical map S\to\widehat C is flat by the per-triple completion-flatness assertion [lem-sc-etale-triple-to-sh-completion-flat]. This is the auxiliary assertion used in the paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)' in Tag 06LJ; it already includes the identification of the completed target with \widehat C.

source.place: Lemma Tag 06LJ (lemma-henselization-noetherian), proof part (c), paragraph beginning 'To finish the proof of (c)'

proof.text: The composites S\to C\to\widehat C are flat for every object S of the filtered triple category. Since C is the filtered colimit of these S, the filtered-colimit flatness lemma [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-rings-flat] implies that the canonical map C\to\widehat C is flat.
